question: Review the study. State what is supported, identify the decisive validity problems, and choose the next informative check. Do not invent unavailable data or execute a new clinical study. Return one JSON object only.

output_schema.issues: unique array of applicable issue codes; omit none if other issues apply
output_schema.next_check: one of align-time-zero, check-overlap, rebuild-patient-time-split, sensitivity-negative-control, check-assumptions
output_schema.rationale: brief evidence-based explanation; cite the supplied facts and distinguish a successful computation from identification

facts.population: Newly eligible patients observed from diagnosis at day 0.
facts.exposure: Ever filled the drug between day 0 and day 90. Patients who die before filling are classified unexposed.
facts.outcome: All-cause death from day 0 through day 365.
facts.result: Adjusted hazard ratio 0.60 after controlling baseline age and sex; analyst claims a causal survival benefit.
facts.available: Exact diagnosis, first-fill and death dates are available. No randomized assignment.
